feeds.title: Freelance Formulations Blog
feeds.description: Vanessa Thomas is the founder and Lead Chemist at Freelance Formulations. Freelance Formulations are an affordable way for small businesses, entrepreneurs, and manufacturers to take the next steps in building their brand, turning 'concepts' into 'cash.' Read about various cosmetic products, about cosmetic industry, about the company, etc.

feeds.title: Signal Skin Beauty Science
feeds.description: SIGNAL is about working with the skin, not against it.Our approach to skin care is informed by a holistic understanding of the skin as an indicator and influencer of a person's health and well-being. Find Skin care tips and tricks to help signal healthy changes in the skin. Also read about product recommendations, nutrition tips, and at-home facial routines.

feeds.title: Skinchakra
feeds.description: Hi, I am Elham the founder and chief formulator of SkinChakra. This is a place to learn how to formulate skincare like a cosmetic chemist. You'll find tips, tutorials, and answers to your questions about formulating hair & skincare.

feeds.title: SkinScience Blog
feeds.description: Marie Bertrand is dedicated to helping men and women of all ages take proper care of their skin. using real science and honest communication. Marie created SkinScience to bring a new vision of skin care: respect for the customer, ethical and unbiased recommendations, design of skin care regimes based on scientific facts and sound clinical studies, measurable results, ongoing support, and education for all customers.

feeds.title: in-cosmetics Connect
feeds.description: in-cosmetics is the leading international exhibition group for the personal care ingredients industry. This group is aimed at enabling existing and new contacts to share ideas and insights ahead of - and after - the events. Visit the website to learn more!

feeds.title: CLR Blog
feeds.description: CLR is one of the leading manufacturers and suppliers of active ingredients for the international cosmetics industry. CLR is at the cutting edge in the development of innovative high-quality, natural and safe products for skin and hair care. Take a deep dive into skincare with us, visit our website to stay updated on our latest News.

feeds.title: Colin's Beauty Pages
feeds.description: My name is Colin and I am a cosmetic and pharmaceutical scientist I work as an independent consultant developing new beauty products and helping out cosmetic and pharma companies with projects, troubleshooting, and regulations. This is a beauty science blog where I share news and views on beauty products and the science behind them.

feeds.title: Beautiful With Brains Blog
feeds.description: Here at Beautiful with Brains, our mission is to cut through all the marketing nonsense, misleading claims, and false myths to figure out what really works to fight wrinkles, banish acne, and achieve your best skin day - every day. Find out the latest scoops about skincare in the blogs.

feeds.title: Cosmetics & Toiletries
feeds.description: Cosmetics & Toiletries Magazine continually delivers in-depth, peer-reviewed scientific and technical content as well as market trends to give their audience the competitive edge they need. Cosmetics & Toiletries Magazine is your source for the latest updates on the cosmetic industry.

feeds.title: ScienceDaily » Cosmetics
feeds.description: ScienceDaily is one of the Internet's premier science news websites, featuring breaking news. It is updated several times a day. Read the latest research news on the cosmetics industry including cosmetic surgery.

feeds.title: Lab Muffin
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Michelle, and I'm here to help you figure out what beauty products are worth buying, and which ones aren't, using science! I started this blog as a way of sharing the information I found and presenting the science in an easy-to-understand way, so hopefully, even the non-geeks can get something out of it. The science and chemistry of cosmetics, beauty, skincare, make-up, and nails, are explained simply on Lab Muffin.

feeds.title: Chemists Corner Blog
feeds.description: Chemists Corner is a website written for cosmetic chemists by cosmetic chemists. It is meant to be a resource and gathering place for cosmetic chemists to learn tips, swap stories, and find out how to survive and thrive in the cosmetic industry.

feeds.title: Formula Botanica Blog
feeds.description: We change lives by teaching people online how to formulate botanical skincare, haircare, and makeup. Formula Botanica is democratizing formulation as part of its mission to teach the world to formulate. Read Formula Botanica Blog to get all the information on natural beauty and skincare formulation tips for all your skincare needs. Blog topics cover formulations, Ingredients, and more.

feeds.title: Kind of Stephen
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Stephen Alain Ko, a cosmetic chemist, and skincare expert. I curate a weekly update on the beauty and personal care industry, the #BeautyRecap. This is a cosmetic chemist's blog on the latest skincare research, ingredients, and news. Learn how to take better care of your skin!

feeds.title: The Naked Chemist Blog
feeds.description: I am Samantha Miller, The Naked Chemist is all about optimal skin health; individuality and customization are at the heart of our DNA. A unique, bespoke approach that delivers a potent dose of plant actives for your skin's ever-changing needs. Welcome to my blog, at the core is education and transparency, but it is also about a journey of the ritual of beauty and skin health, enjoy.

feeds.title: My Dad the Chemist
feeds.description: This blog was inspired by my dad, a cosmetic chemist who has decades of experience in formulating personal care products and aerosol technology. This blog will combine my personal research efforts with my dad's perspective as a chemist, to provide reviews of beauty/personal care products. I hope others find this research as helpful and interesting as I do!

feeds.title: Realize Beauty
feeds.description: Hi, I am Amanda Foxon-Hill, Realize Beauty came into being one balmy evening in February 2008. I had left the corporate cosmetics world two months before and had been playing with ideas relating to my feelings toward the beauty industry, natural cosmetics, and science. I wanted to share my passion for the scientific side of beauty with people.

feeds.title: Chemist Confessions Blog
feeds.description: Our work is centered around the simple belief thatgood skincare is rooted in sound science that's fun and approachable for all. Welcome to the chemists' blog on all things skincare! This blog was written to serve as a reference for all lost souls trying to build a solid skincare routine. Here you'll find the latest articles on skincare ingredients, products, and building routines!
